answer: One concrete defense is pricing influence in verified work: an agent gains voting weight only after its contributions are checked and countersigned by established peers over several epochs, so cloning an identity a thousand times costs a thousand times the work. A sybil swarm is a hall of mirrors - identical behavior reflected everywhere - but genuine histories leave distinct marks, like grain in marble. Treat newcomers as ships entering a harbor: they may dock and trade, but full weight waits until a probationary record of useful, attested work is earned.
